segments.name: Immunotherapies
segments.description: Develops transformative immunomodulating medicines using the ImmTAX platform for patients with cancer, infectious diseases and autoimmune diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one operating segment: immunotherapies, which is focused on pioneering and delivering transformative immunomodulating medicines in the areas of cancer, infectious diseases and autoimmune diseases.

revenueModel.text: The company generates revenue primarily from sales of its approved therapy KIMMTRAK to customers in the countries where it is commercially launched.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company primarily generates revenue from one stream, revenue from the sale of therapies, which consists of sales of KIMMTRAK.
